title: Meghalaya Trip Cost Calculator 2026–27 (Free, No Signup)
description: Work out a Meghalaya trip budget in ₹: Guwahati to Shillong, Cherrapunji and Dawki, by SUV with driver, shared cab or rented bike. Free, no signup.
lead: Meghalaya is where a group's transport choice decides the whole budget. A private SUV with a driver, shared sumos or rented bikes all land in very different places, and the entry fees are easy to forget. Pick your choices and see the total in rupees, per person and for the whole group.
seasonNote: The dry months run October to April. Monsoon June to September brings the waterfalls at their fullest and the slides, washouts and leeches with them. Dawki boating and the root-bridge treks can close without notice in heavy rain.
hubBlurb: Guwahati–Shillong–Cherrapunji–Dawki, priced the way groups actually travel it.

classic-5.label: Classic circuit
classic-5.note: The route almost every first Meghalaya trip runs, about 500 km from Guwahati and back.

full-7.label: Meghalaya + Kaziranga
full-7.note: Adds the Kaziranga drives and a safari morning: about 950 km in all. The Assam leg is long, so the days go up with it.

weekend-3.label: Shillong weekend
weekend-3.note: Three days out of Guwahati, with no Dawki run. The tight version.

custom.label: Custom
custom.note: Enter the distance you actually plan to cover.

groups.hint: A private SUV with a driver is how most Indian groups do Meghalaya. Shared sumos are much cheaper and much slower.

lines.name: Private SUV with driver
lines.hint: An Innova or Bolero-class car with a driver, for the five-day Guwahati loop. Operators quote about ₹5,500 a day for an Ertiga and ₹7,600 for an Innova; check whether tolls and the driver's stay are in the quote.

lines.name: Shared cabs
lines.rateLabel: Shared cabs, per person per day
lines.hint: Shared sumos between Guwahati, Shillong, Cherrapunji and Dawki. They leave when full, so a day can go on waiting.

lines.name: Fuel (rented bikes)
lines.hint: One bike between two people. Hill mileage is worse than the number you get at home.

lines.name: Bike rent
lines.rateLabel: Bike rent, per bike per day
lines.hint: Shillong and Guwahati rentals. Bike taxis are restricted in parts of Shillong, so check what your rental allows before you book.

lines.name: Entry fees and boating
lines.hint: Mawsmai cave ₹20–₹50, the eco parks ₹20, the Nongriat entry ₹20 and the Dawki boat at ₹500–₹1,200 a boat, split across four. A couple of extra sites sit inside this allowance.

lines.name: Local guide
lines.offLabel: Not included, add a guide if you want one
lines.hint: The Double Decker root bridge at Nongriat and several cave walks are not safe to do unguided. The East Khasi Hills advisory asks for a registered guide on those treks; this is the group price, not a per-person one.

lines.name: Stay
lines.tierHint: Price per room per night. Two people share a room.

lines.name: Buffer
lines.hint: Rain gear, a poncho you buy twice, parking, and the things nobody plans for.

faqs.q: How much does a private cab cost in Meghalaya for 5 days?
faqs.a: An Innova or Bolero-class SUV with a driver runs about ₹5,500 to ₹7,500 a day for the Guwahati–Shillong–Cherrapunji–Dawki loop, and five days is the usual quote. That is ₹27,500 to ₹37,500 for the car, split across your group, so four people pay roughly ₹6,900 to ₹9,400 each for transport alone. The driver's food and stay are usually settled separately at the end of the trip, and are not in this figure.

faqs.q: What is the Meghalaya budget per person for 4 friends?
faqs.a: With the default settings here, four people on the 5-day classic circuit in a private SUV with a driver, staying in homestays and eating locally, the calculator lands near ₹12,300 to ₹19,300 per person. That is ₹49,100 to ₹77,100 for the group. Shared cabs bring transport down sharply and add waiting time; rented bikes sit in between and are the most fun in the dry months.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit or registration for Meghalaya?
faqs.a: No. Indian nationals need no permit or paid registration for Meghalaya. Foreign nationals have their own registration rule, so check that with the state tourism site. Some individual sights, such as the Double Decker root bridge and Dawki boating, charge their own fees and are covered by the entry line. The East Khasi Hills advisory asks for a registered guide on the Nongriat treks, and the optional guide line prices that for the whole group.

faqs.q: Should we rent bikes or take a cab in Meghalaya?
faqs.a: Bikes are cheaper on paper, about ₹1,200 to ₹1,800 a bike a day plus fuel, and one bike between two people works well for a group of four. But the roads climb hard and the rain arrives fast, and some Shillong roads restrict bike taxis. A cab with a driver costs more and takes the driving and the bike rental out of the trip. Switch the Getting around option above and compare both totals rather than the daily rate.

faqs.q: What are the best months to visit Meghalaya?
faqs.a: October to April is the dry season, and the window most trips plan for. Cherrapunji and Mawsynram are the wettest places in India, and June to September brings the waterfalls at their fullest along with slides, washed-out roads and trails that close without notice. The ranges here are a dry-season week. If you go in the monsoon, add to the buffer and expect to drop a day.
